author: NetworkChuck
description:
AI writes most of your pull requests now, but you're the one clicking merge. CodeRabbit reads every file first and shows you what it breaks. Start a free 14-day CodeRabbit trial with my link. No credit card required: https://ntck.co/coderabbit


Git is the game save for your code. Before I walk into the scary room in Resident Evil, I save on the typewriter, and before your AI agent touches your code, you should too. So we build a tiny repo (a website and a zombie story), then save it, break it, restore it, and jump back in time with the DeLorean. Then we branch off the sacred timeline, put it on GitHub, hand issues to an AI agent, and commit a timeline crime on purpose so you know how to fix it. In this video you'll learn what Git actually is (and why it is not GitHub), how staging, commits, git log and git diff work, how to time travel with git checkout and git restore, how branches and merges work, and how issues, pull requests and merge conflicts let you work alongside an AI agent
title: you need to learn Git RIGHT NOW!!
